channel.title: AI GridWatch — Wisconsin data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Wisconsin, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Chippewa County: data center moratorium — Enacted
La Crosse: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 18-month moratorium approved by Common Council, matching the county's Jun 18 moratorium. Covers facilities >1 PB or >2 MW. Plan commission advanced it Aug 3

item.title: Manitowoc County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 18-month pause, unanimous; covers facilities with more than 1 PB of storage. Requested by three towns (Two Creeks, Two Rivers, Mishicot) after land-purchase approaches to farmers

item.title: Madison: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Up to 1-year moratorium on zoning for data centers >10,000 sq ft, unanimous. Evaluating electricity, water, land use, and community benefit impacts

item.title: Town of Cassville: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 2-year moratorium, unanimous. 36 sq mi in Grant County. Residents mobilized against a \$1B proposed project

item.title: Manitowoc County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 18-month moratorium, unanimous. Towns of Two Creeks, Two Rivers, and Mishicot requested the pause after a developer approached property owners. Farmland-loss concerns

item.title: Dane County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 18-month moratorium on hyperscale data centers in county zoning areas. Advisory committee to study benefits and pitfalls

item.title: Village of Wrightstown: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium, unanimous. Cloverleaf Infrastructure proposed ~1 GW AI data center in region. Aug 2026 advisory referendum: 87%% voted village should NOT authorize public improvements for large data centers

item.title: Superior: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium, unanimous. City lacks zoning definitions for data center sizes. Planning commission reviewing zoning and infrastructure recommendations

item.title: Wisconsin: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: SB 1061 — would halt operations at existing data centers until legislature enacts protections. Would ban shifting energy/water costs onto residential customers. Not yet voted on

item.title: Dodge County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 18-month moratorium on data-center development in county-zoned unincorporated areas, approved 29-2 by the Board of Supervisors after a public hearing. Initiated by Supervisor Cathy Houchin following constituent concerns about a Beaver Dam-area data center's impact on water.

item.title: La Crosse County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 18-month pause in unincorporated areas; county stood up an ad hoc committee to study data centers, and the city of La Crosse is taking part in that work while drafting its own rules
